caption: The drawing depicts a single two-pronged fork made of metal, displayed horizontally across the center of a light beige background. The handle on the left side is flat and elongated with a slight curve and a hook-like bend at the end. The handle transitions into a section of twisted metal in the middle. To the right, there is a rectangular section leading to the fork’s head, which consists of two long, pointed prongs that angle slightly outward from each other. The entire fork is depicted in brown and rust-colored tones, suggesting an aged or oxidized metal surface. Near the left side of the drawing, there is text in capital letters that reads "ROY WEBER."
title: Pa. German Fork
